desc.mod_70022c7a.craft2: With a potion, damage is replaced by the potion effect
desc.mod_70022c7a.craft_hint: Various materials can add effects to your arrows
label.mod_70022c7a.upgrade_line: Insert a metal block as upgrade material to unlock more features
hint.mod_70022c7a.remainder: Remaining supply: %s/%s arrows (a piece is consumed only when fully used)
hint.mod_70022c7a.locked_last: Partially used: the last piece cannot be taken out
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.0: Feather slot: 1 feather per arrow; craft as many as materials allow.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.1: Stick slot: 1 stick per arrow; 1 plank covers 8 arrows.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.2: Arrowhead slot: each head material supplies a fixed number of arrows (see the guide), consumed per arrow with banking; leave empty for no arrowhead (no bonus damage). 1 potion = 8 potion arrows (no arrow damage, applies the potion effect).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.3: Effect slot 1 (Copper tier): firework rocket, potion, blaze powder, gunpowder, glowstone dust or slime ball. Normal materials: 1 per 4 arrows; potions: 1 bottle per 8.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.4: Effect slot 2 (Iron tier): one more effect. 1 material per 4 arrows; potions 1 per 8.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.5: Effect slot 3 (Gold tier): one more effect. 1 material per 4 arrows; potions 1 per 8.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.6: Effect slot 4 (Diamond tier): one more effect. 1 material per 4 arrows; potions 1 per 8.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.7: Effect slot 5 (Netherite tier): one more effect. 1 material per 4 arrows; potions 1 per 8.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.8: Output slot: shows how many arrows current materials can make; take it to craft and consume them. Up to a full stack (64) per craft.
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.9: Arrow slot: put modified arrows here to enchant (Gold tier).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.10: Lapis slot: each enchant consumes 1-3 lapis lazuli (Gold tier).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.11: Output slot: enchanted arrows appear here (Gold tier).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.12: Bow slot: put a bow here for modification (Netherite tier).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.13: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.14: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.15: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.16: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.17: Bow material slot: firework rocket (strong boost), blaze powder (flame) or glowstone dust (focus).
hint.mod_70022c7a.slot.18: Upgrade slot: insert the next metal block (copper, iron, gold, diamond, netherite block) to upgrade instantly, consuming 1. The ghost icon shows the required block.
tooltip.mod_70022c7a.potion_only: Potion arrow: no arrow damage, effects only
tooltip.mod_70022c7a.rocket: Rocket boost: high speed, low drop
